camel_example: aliyun ehpc ListAvailableEcsTypes --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --InstanceChargeType PostPaid --SpotStrategy NoSpot --ShowSoldOut false
description_en: You can call ListAvailableEcsTypes to query available ECS instance types
description_zh: 调用ListAvailableEcsTypes查询可用的ECS实例规格资源
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-available-ecs-types --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --spot-strategy NoSpot --instance-charge-type PostPaid --show-sold-out false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAvailableEcsTypes

parameters.help_en:
The preemption policy for the ECS instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: The instance is a pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is a spot instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is a spot instance for which the system automatically bids based on the current market price
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例抢占策略。取值范围：
NoSpot：按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例
parameters.name: spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the ECS instance. Valid values:

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
PrePaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例的付费类型。取值范围：
PostPaid：按量付费
PrePaid：包年包月
parameters.name: instance_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display sold-out ECS instance types. Valid values:

false: The instance type is not sold out.
true: The instance type is sold out.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示ECS实例已售罄。取值范围：
false：未售罄
true：已售罄

默认值：false
parameters.name: show_sold_out

InstanceTypeFamilyInfo.description_en: The instance family to which the instance type belongs

Generation.description_en: The generation of the instance family

EniQuantity.description_en: The maximum number of elastic network interfaces (ENIs) that can be attached to the ECS instance
EniQuantity.description_zh: ECS实例支持挂载的弹性网卡上限

GPUAmount.description_en: The number of GPUs for the ECS instance

GPUSpec.description_en: The GPU type of the ECS instance

InstanceBandwidthRx.description_en: The maximum inbound internal bandwidth. Unit: kbit/s
InstanceBandwidthRx.description_zh: 内网入方向带宽限制。单位：kbit/s

InstanceBandwidthTx.description_en: The maximum outbound internal bandwidth. Unit: kbit/s
InstanceBandwidthTx.description_zh: 内网出方向带宽限制。单位：kbit/s

InstancePpsRx.description_en: The inbound packet forwarding rate over the internal network. Unit: pps
InstancePpsRx.description_zh: 内网入方向网络收发包能力。单位：Pps

InstancePpsTx.description_en: The outbound packet forwarding rate over the internal network. Unit: pps
InstancePpsTx.description_zh: 内网出方向网络收发包能力。单位：Pps

InstanceTypeId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance type

MemorySize.description_en: The memory size of the ECS instance. Unit: GiB

Status.description_en:
The status of the ECS instance type. Possible values:

SoldOut: The resource is sold out.
Available: The resource is available
Status.description_zh:
ECS实例状态。可能值：
SoldOut：资源已售罄
Available：资源充足

SupportSpotInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether spot instances are supported. Possible values:

false: Not supported.
true: Supported
SupportSpotInstance.description_zh:
是否支持抢占式实例。可能值：
false：不支持
true：支持
